From Smooth Operators · Price: only markings and shallow wounds, moved by touch.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: slide a marking, label or sign from one surface to another within reach.
  • 5: Slide a shallow wound: move persistent bleed damage from an ally to an object.
  • 9: Surge: slide an ally's condition (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy}, value 1) onto an adjacent enemy (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).
  • 13: Slide conditions of value 2.
  • 17: Slide a creature's features off: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} and can't be recognized for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
